lines.text: The roots know this room. They grow away from it. Listen to that before you touch anything.
There is a garden on the roof here. Three plants. Somebody waters them.
The ground under the plaza is quiet now. It was not before. I keep my hands in it.
The current runs strong here. Step where it pools; it will hold you up.
They are in the Weft now. Everything is, in the end.
The Bastion has roots. Did you know? Under the plaza. They are very old.
